notes.title: Zoo Constructor - finally opens!
notes.content:
[i]If you like Zoo Tycoons this ones for you:[/i]
[h1][b]Zoo Constructor[/b][/h1]- [b]Construct and manage an animal park![/b] 
Economic simulation with complex animal, climate and plant simulation. The constructor has tools for soil, water, roads, fences and plants, personnel, visitor facilities and decorations available. Have fun!

-------------------------------
New Features v1.12:
-------------------------------
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Leaderboards
[*] snackbooth
[*] objectives parklevel 5
[*] 8 animal species 
[*] orangutan
[*] yak
[*] leopard
[*] flamingo
[*] ostrich
[*] kangaroo
[*] armadillo
[*] racoon
[*] 5 new fences 
[*] map sahara 
[*] some balancing and minor bugs fixed
[*] 
[/list]
